items.question: Which engine powers the AS350 B3e?
items.explanation: B3e is equipped with a Turbomeca Arriel 2D engine.

items.question: What is the Arriel 2D maximum takeoff power rating (MTOP)?
items.explanation: MTOP (uninstalled, ISA, sea level) is 641 kW (860 SHP).

items.question: What is the Arriel 2D maximum continuous power rating (MCP)?
items.explanation: MCP is 551 kW (739 SHP).

items.question: What is the main rotor diameter on the AS350 B3e?
items.explanation: The main rotor diameter is 10.69 m (35.07 ft).

items.question: What is the nominal main rotor speed?
items.explanation: Nominal NR is 386 rpm.

items.question: What is the nominal tail rotor speed?
items.explanation: Nominal tail rotor speed is 2044 rpm.

items.question: What is the total fuel capacity?
items.explanation: Total fuel capacity is 540 l (427 kg).

items.question: What is the usable fuel in the standard tank?
items.explanation: Usable fuel (standard tank) is 538.7 l (425.6 kg).

items.question: What is the usable fuel in the crash resistant tank?
items.explanation: Usable fuel (crash resistant tank) is 538 l (425 kg).

items.question: On the Caution and Warning Panel, what do red and amber lights indicate?
options: Red: immediate action; Amber: action can be delayed
Red: maintenance only; Amber: immediate action
Red: audio only; Amber: visual only
items.explanation: Red warning lights require immediate action; amber caution lights allow action to be delayed.

items.question: How are audio warnings activated?
options: Set [HORN] to ON on the central console
Set [INV] to ON on the overhead panel
Set [GENE] to OFF on the console
Set [BATT] to ON on the console
items.explanation: Audio alarms are generated through the ICS and are activated when [HORN] is set to ON.

items.question: What supplies the Caution and Warning Panel (CWP)?
options: Dual 28 VDC power supply protected by circuit breakers
items.explanation: The CWP is supplied by a dual 28 VDC power supply and protected by circuit breakers.

items.question: Where are WACS and FDR fault indicators installed (post MOD 07-20112 or MOD 07-20228)?
items.explanation: WACS and FDR fault indicators are installed on the overhead panel.

items.question: Which audio tone corresponds to an MTOP overlimit?
items.explanation: ASU No.1 manages audio warnings: Gong for red alarms; continuous low tone for MTOP overlimit.

items.question: How is the VEMD architected?
options: Two processing modules (LANE 1 & LANE 2) and one display module
One processing module and two display modules
Three display modules and a single processing unit
Two FADEC channels and one display module
items.explanation: The VEMD comprises LANE 1, LANE 2 processing modules and a display module with two screens.

items.question: Which operating modes are available on the VEMD?
items.explanation: Three modes: OPERATIONAL (engine/vehicle/FLI/flight report/engine power check), CONFIGURATION, and MAINTENANCE.

items.question: Where is the hydraulic cut-off switch located?
items.explanation: The hydraulic cut-off switch is a guarded switch mounted on the collective grip.

items.question: Which sources supply the DC electrical network?
options: Starter-generator, 15 Ah battery (optional second), 28 V EPU
Two alternators and a 12 V battery
items.explanation: The DC network is supplied by a starter-generator, a 15 Ah battery (optional second) and a 28 V external power unit.

items.question: What does the PITOT amber caution indicate?
options: Pitot heating not operating, switch OFF or system failure
Static ports blocked by ice only
items.explanation: An amber PITOT caution indicates the heating system is not operating, the [PITOT] switch is OFF, or the system has failed.

items.question: Post MOD 07-20039, what is the hydraulic system regulating pressure?
items.explanation: The regulator is set to 60 bar (870 psi) post MOD 07-20039 (40 bar pre-mod).
